description: IPC the main window and every overlay widget window are allowed to use: core invoke/event plumbing, the dialog plugin's Rust-side API that pick_log_directory calls on the window's behalf, and the updater plugin backing the in-app update check/install flow (restart itself is a core AppHandle call, not a separate plugin). Each overlay widget is its own real OS window labeled `overlay-<widget>` (see commands::overlay_label) -- 'overlay-*' is a glob so a new widget never needs a capabilities edit to get IPC. Each only ever calls a few read-only commands and listens for parse-tick/overlay-opacity, but there's no narrower stock permission bundle than core:default to hand it -- see windowcap.rs's own doc for why it exists behind a runtime capability check regardless of what IPC it's allowed.
